newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 540,000 lbs luncheon meat for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 540,000 lbs luncheon meat for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was seeking to buy 540,000 lbs of canned luncheon, for use in Federal food assistance programs.
Current program requirements for canned meat will be met with the purchase of the quantity listed in this Invitation.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-46 and be received by 1400 EST in Washington, D.C., on Monday, December 30, 1996. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, January 3, 1997.
Shipments must be made between March 12 and 27, 1997.
